question: What outcome is said to follow from abstaining from food by day?
premises: A movement toward death is stated
The death is qualified by age
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death by age.
uncertainties: vayo mṛtyuṃ may mean natural death in old age rather than premature death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to death by old age.
